data.feature_name: Learn & Apply to Sequencer Right-Click Menu Option

risks.risk: User cancels PatternPreviewDialog after saving to database - pattern saved but not applied to sequencer
risks.mitigation: Result.accepted only returns true when user clicks 'Save Patterns'. If canceled (Result.accepted = false), simply do not apply to sequencer. This is expected behavior - database save and sequencer injection are coupled in this feature.

risks.risk: StepSequencer has user-edited pattern that will be overwritten without warning
risks.mitigation: MUST implement overwrite warning. Check if grid has any non-zero cells before applyPatternSet(). Show confirmation dialog: 'This will modify your current pattern. Continue?' Options: [Cancel] [Apply & Merge] [Apply & Replace]. Consider offering 'Merge' mode that OR's new pattern with existing.

risks.risk: PatternPreviewDialog callback may execute on wrong thread
risks.mitigation: Verified: showDialogAsync() uses DialogWindow::LaunchOptions which runs modally on message thread. The callback passed to showDialogAsync is invoked from onClose handler within JUCE message thread context. Safe to call applyPatternSet() directly. Add defensive jassert(juce::MessageManager::getInstance()->isThisTheMessageThread()).

risks.risk: Pattern has 32/48/64 steps but StepSequencer is configured for 16 steps - data loss or crash
risks.mitigation: applyPatternSet() at line 2982-2992 already handles this - calls setBars() to resize grid if targetSteps != current grid size. However, verify setBars() clamps to valid range (1-4 bars = 16-64 steps). For patterns > 64 steps, truncation will occur. Log warning if pattern exceeds max supported steps.

risks.risk: Adding many dynamic rows via addTrackRow() causes performance/memory issues
risks.mitigation: addTrackRow() at line 3267 is O(1) append operation. Each row adds: 1 grid vector, 1 File, 5 bools/enums, 1 ChannelGenerateButton. Memory per row is ~200 bytes + button component. Even 20 rows = ~4KB + 20 buttons. Acceptable. Consider cap at 16 rows for UI sanity.

risks.risk: Pattern contains DrumCategory::Unknown or DrumCategory::Custom with no matching sequencer row
risks.mitigation: applyPatternSet() at line 2999-3071 iterates existing rows and matches by category. Unknown/Custom categories won't match any row and pattern data is silently dropped. For 'Learn & Apply' feature, should create new row via addTrackRow() for unmatched categories. Evidence shows subcategoryPatterns are matched by name, not category.

risks.risk: No undo support - user cannot revert sequencer to previous state
risks.mitigation: Codebase has saveState() calls (18 occurrences) but no UndoManager integration found. saveState() persists to preferences, not undo stack. For MVP: Document that action is not undoable. Future: Implement getState()/setState() capture before applyPatternSet() and store in undo stack.

risks.risk: PatternPreviewDialog::Result to PatternSet conversion loses subcategory information
risks.mitigation: Result contains PatternEntry with isSubcategory flag, subcategoryName, and displayName. Must convert properly: for each PatternEntry where isSubcategory=true, create SubcategoryPattern and add to PatternSet.subcategoryPatterns map. Evidence report shows this conversion path at lines 90-95.

risks.risk: Visual highlight on affected rows not implemented - user doesn't see what changed
risks.mitigation: applyPatternSet() calls repaint() at line 3076. This repaints entire grid but doesn't highlight changed rows. For MVP: repaint() is sufficient - cells visually update. Future enhancement: flash affected rows with temporary highlight color (e.g., 500ms yellow fade).

risks.risk: stepSequencer_ pointer may be null when callback executes
risks.mitigation: Evidence shows stepSequencer_ is owned by SampleBrowserPage (unique_ptr at line 385). Dialog callback captures 'this' (SampleBrowserPage). Use SafePointer pattern: juce::Component::SafePointer<SampleBrowserPage> safeThis(this). Check safeThis and stepSequencer_ before use.

risks.risk: gridSize mismatch between PatternSet and current StepSequencer bars
risks.mitigation: PatternSet.gridSize can be 12, 16, 24, 32, 48, 64 steps. StepSequencer setBars() supports 1-16 bars (16-256 steps). The applyPatternSet() function handles this at line 2985-2992 by calling setBars(targetBars) where targetBars = (targetSteps + 15) / 16 clamped to 1-4. Patterns > 64 steps will be clamped to 4 bars.

risks.risk: Sequencer tempo may differ from pattern BPM - tempo conflict
risks.mitigation: PatternPreviewDialog::Result includes finalBpm field. After applyPatternSet(), should call stepSequencer_->setTempo(result.finalBpm) to sync tempo. This ensures sequencer plays at correct BPM for the learned pattern. Warn user if tempo differs by > 10 BPM from current.

edge_cases.input: Empty pattern (all PatternEntry.pattern vectors are zero)
edge_cases.risk: User confusion - pattern applied but no visible change
edge_cases.handling: Check if any pattern has active steps before applying. Show info message if no pattern detected.

edge_cases.input: Pattern with only subcategories (no base Kick/Snare/HiHat)
edge_cases.risk: applyPatternSet() only matches existing rows - subcategory-only patterns won't apply
edge_cases.handling: For each unmatched subcategory in PatternSet, call addTrackRow() with appropriate DrumTrack.

edge_cases.expected: No new rows added, only matching rows updated
edge_cases.risk: Potential UI overflow or pattern data loss
edge_cases.handling: Check getRowCount() before addTrackRow(). If at max, only update existing matching rows.
Check Result.accepted first, return early if false.

edge_cases.input: Rapid repeated 'Learn & Apply' on multiple loops
edge_cases.risk: Accumulated rows from multiple patterns could exceed limits
edge_cases.handling: Consider 'Replace All' mode that clears sequencer before applying new pattern.

edge_cases.input: Pattern with triplet grid (12/24 steps) applied to binary sequencer
edge_cases.risk: Triplet quantization may not feel correct on binary grid
edge_cases.handling: setBars() handles resize. Document that triplet patterns may need manual adjustment.

known_problems_from_research.problem: Categories without existing rows are silently skipped
known_problems_from_research.solution: Feature must add dynamic rows for unmatched categories using addTrackRow()

known_problems_from_research.problem: Existing implementation only saves to database, doesn't inject to sequencer
known_problems_from_research.solution: Add callback logic after showDialogAsync() to also call applyPatternSet()

known_problems_from_research.problem: No undo mechanism exists for sequencer operations
known_problems_from_research.applies_to: User expectation of Ctrl+Z to revert
known_problems_from_research.solution: Document limitation or implement state snapshot before apply

codebase_precedents.description: openPatternLibraryDialog() shows modal dialog, on selection calls applyPatternSet()
codebase_precedents.relevance: Proven pattern for dialog -> applyPatternSet() flow - use same structure

codebase_precedents.description: learnPatternFromAudio() extracts patterns and shows PatternPreviewDialog
codebase_precedents.relevance: Exact starting point - extend callback to inject to sequencer
Use same SafePointer pattern for callback safety

must_have: SafePointer usage in callback to prevent dangling reference
Check stepSequencer_ != nullptr before calling applyPatternSet()
Convert PatternPreviewDialog::Result to PatternSet correctly (including subcategories)
Sync sequencer tempo with Result.finalBpm after pattern application
should_have: Overwrite confirmation dialog if sequencer has non-empty pattern
Create dynamic rows for unmatched categories via addTrackRow()
Log all operations for debugging (function entry, result status, pattern stats)
Handle grid size mismatch gracefully (log warning if truncation occurs)
nice_to_have: Visual flash/highlight on affected rows after pattern applied
Undo support via state snapshot before applyPatternSet()
Merge mode option (OR patterns instead of replace)
Row count limit check before adding dynamic rows

test_cases_for_verification.expected: Confirmation dialog appears (if implemented) or pattern replaced
New rows created for Conga, Shaker etc.

test_cases_for_verification.expected: User informed no patterns detected OR empty pattern applied

data.overall_assessment: Feature is LOW-MEDIUM risk. No critical blocking issues. Three HIGH severity risks require attention: R2 (overwrite warning), R4 (step count mismatch handled by existing code), R8 (subcategory conversion). The codebase already provides solid infrastructure via applyPatternSet() and addTrackRow(). Main implementation work is Result-to-PatternSet conversion and optional UX enhancements like overwrite confirmation.
data.recommendation: PROCEED with implementation. Address HIGH risks R2, R4, R8 in design. All other risks have acceptable mitigations or are existing codebase behaviors.
